The '''Battles of the Black Delve''' was a series of conflicts during the [[690s BBY]] in which the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Judicial Forces/Legends|Judicial Forces]] played a key role. It shared its name with<ref name="Warfare" /> [[The Black Delve/Legends|the Black Delve]], a location in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region's]] [[Har Worlds]] [[Sector/Legends|sector]].<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Battles of the Black Delve were mentioned in the [[2012]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]].<ref name="Warfare" />
